$comment: Shipped non-core components of the Relay client, curated by hand where no manifest states the fact (licence, copyright, category) and joined with exact versions from Apps/Relay.xcodeproj/.../Package.resolved by Scripts/relay-licenses.py. Emulator cores come from Resources/CoreManifest.json, not from here. 'shipped: false' entries are build-time tools recorded for completeness and excluded from the app's list.

components.name: Relay
components.description: The Relay client packages and app shells.

components.name: Provenance support packages
components.licenseNote: BSD-3-Clause with a clause reserving the Provenance name, logo and branding from commercial redistribution.
components.copyright: © 2024 Joseph Mattiello (MattiMedia) and Provenance contributors; portions © 2009–2014 OpenEmu Team; portions © 2013–2015 James Addyman; portions © 2015 Josejulio Martínez; one file © 2018–2019 Apple Inc. and the Swift Distributed Actors project authors (Apache-2.0)
components.description: The emulation plumbing Relay inherited and links: PVEmulatorCore, PVCoreBridge, PVCoreObjCBridge, PVCoreAudio, PVAudio, PVLogging, PVSupport, PVSettings, PVPlists, PVPrimitives, PVHashing, PVObjCUtils, PVNetplay, PVPatching, and the PVmGBACore/PVmGBABridge wrapper.
components.modifications: Relay's changes are listed in Vendor/Provenance/RELAY_MODIFICATIONS.md and shipped as source under Vendor/Provenance.

components.copyright: The RetroArch team and credited contributors

components.name: rcheevos
components.description: Official RetroAchievements runtime, emulator-session API client, game hashing, achievement evaluation and progress serialization. Optional and free.
components.modifications: Runtime, API and hashing sources are unmodified. Relay replaces the SwiftPM manifest and module map, preserving originals in upstream-build; see Vendor/rcheevos/RELAY_VENDOR.json.

components.name: MD5 for rcheevos
components.copyright: Copyright (C) 1999, 2000, 2002 Aladdin Enterprises. All rights reserved.
components.description: MD5 implementation used by the official RetroAchievements cartridge identification algorithm. It is not used to secure credentials or Relay content identity.

components.name: libretro-database (game titles)
components.description: Game names and checksums from the No-Intro and Redump DATs, as published by libretro-database. Relay derives its offline title catalog from them to name imported games; the catalog holds no images and no game data.
components.modifications: Converted to SQLite (names, SHA-1 checksums and PlayStation serials only) by Scripts/relay-title-catalog.py.
